inputs.title: Agricultural Inputs & Fertilizer Knowledge Base
inputs.subtitle: Learn how fertilizers, micronutrients, biofertilizers, and crop protection chemicals work. Master safe handling, label reading, and balanced nutrition.
inputs.soilTestingBanner: Soil Testing is the Foundation: Always test your soil once every 2–3 years before planning fertilizer schedules. Applying excess chemical fertilizer damages soil biology and increases production costs without increasing yields.
inputs.npkExplanationText: Nitrogen (N) promotes leafy vegetative growth. Phosphorus (P) fuels root development and early vigor. Potassium (K) builds disease resistance, grain/fruit weight, and drought tolerance.
pesticideSafetyPoints: Always wear protective clothing, mask, and rubber gloves when handling chemical formulations.
Never spray against wind direction. Avoid spraying during extreme noon heat.
Adhere strictly to Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI) to prevent harmful residues on marketable produce.
Triple rinse empty chemical containers and dispose of them responsibly—never reuse for household or animal feed purposes.
Only purchase formulations in sealed, manufacturer-labeled packaging from licensed dealers like Rushi Krushi Seva Kendra.
